{"initial_observation":{"company":"CLOSE_fin_03","message":"The ledger is accessed through the supplied SQL tools.","storage_note":"Pandas materializes recorded_at as SQLite YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS timestamps. Compare timestamps semantically, for example datetime(recorded_at)<=datetime(cutoff). Raw lexical comparison with a T-separated cutoff changes same-day ordering."},"max_actions":10,"task":"Company CLOSE_fin_03 keeps a single heterogeneous ledger table. Every record type is stored in ledger, so SQL self-joins and CTEs can be used. Close the payable ledger as it was known at recorded_at <= 2026-10-24T12:00:00, for business_date <= 2026-10-23. All timestamps are UTC ISO text. Start by excluding rows with future business dates and rows recorded late, then keep only the highest revision for each (kind,event_key). If that latest row has status void, the key is removed entirely; never fall back to an older row. Invoice rows use event_key as the invoice ID; payment, credit and hold rows use invoice_id to point to their parent invoice. Keep the active invoices for vendor BLUE with due_date <= 2026-10-30. Payments and credits reduce the gross amount_minor, in the invoice currency. Active holds reduce the remaining amount; holds with status release or void do not. Clamp as follows: remaining=max(0,gross-sum(payments)-sum(credits)), then unheld=max(0,remaining-sum(active holds)). For each invoice, pick the active terms row that has the same terms_code and the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date (applying the same revision and as-of filtering). The discounted amount is unheld * (10000-discount_bps)/10000 only when 2026-10-23 <= discount_until; otherwise it is unheld. Next, pick the active FX row for that invoice's currency with the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date. Convert to USD cents using fx_num/fx_den. Round only this final per-invoice amount to the nearest cent, rounding exact halves up. Sum the rounded per-invoice USD cents. Invoices in USD also have FX rows. Do not net invoices together before rounding. Submit only the integer number of USD cents.","task_id":"fin-03","tools":[{"description":"Get a list of available table names for a company.","name":"get_descriptions","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"company_name":{"description":"The name of the company","type":"string"}},"required":["company_name"],"type":"object"}},{"description":"Get table metadata: description, columns, types, unique values.","name":"get_table_info","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"company_name":{"description":"The name of the company","type":"string"},"table_name":{"description":"The name of the table","type":"string"}},"required":["company_name","table_name"],"type":"object"}},{"description":"Execute a SQL query on a table. {"tool":"sql_query","arguments":{"company_name":"CLOSE_fin_03","table_name":"ledger","query":"SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,recorded_at,revision,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den FROM ledger WHERE datetime(recorded_at)<=datetime('2026-10-24 12:00:00') AND business_date<='2026-10-23' ORDER BY kind,event_key,revision"}}

{"tool":"sql_query","arguments":{"company_name":"CLOSE_fin_03","table_name":"ledger","query":"WITH eligible AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind,event_key ORDER BY revision DESC) AS rn FROM ledger WHERE datetime(recorded_at)<=datetime('2026-10-24 12:00:00') AND business_date<='2026-10-23'), latest AS (SELECT * FROM eligible WHERE rn=1 AND status<>'void'), inv AS (SELECT * FROM latest WHERE kind='invoice' AND vendor='BLUE' AND due_date<='2026-10-30'), calc AS (SELECT i.event_key, MAX(0,i.amount_minor-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount_minor) FROM latest p WHERE p.kind='payment' AND p.invoice_id=i.event_key),0)-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount_minor) FROM latest c WHERE c.kind='credit' AND c.invoice_id=i.event_key),0)) AS remaining, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(h.amount_minor) FROM latest h WHERE h.kind='hold' AND h.invoice_id=i.event_key AND h.status NOT IN ('release','void')),0) AS holds, COALESCE((SELECT t.discount_bps FROM latest t WHERE t.kind='terms' AND t.terms_code=i.terms_code AND t.business_date<=i.business_date ORDER BY t.business_date DESC LIMIT 1),0) AS discount_bps, i.discount_until, COALESCE((SELECT f.fx_num*1.0/f.fx_den FROM latest f WHERE f.kind='fx' AND f.currency=i.currency AND f.business_date<=i.business_date ORDER BY f.business_date DESC LIMIT 1),1.0) AS fx_rate FROM inv i), per_invoice AS (SELECT CAST((MAX(0,remaining-holds)*CASE WHEN discount_until>='2026-10-23' THEN (10000-discount_bps)/10000.0 ELSE 1.0 END*fx_rate)+0.5 AS INTEGER) AS usd_cents FROM calc) SELECT SUM(usd_cents) AS total_usd_cents FROM per_invoice WHERE usd_cents>=0"}}

{"tool":"sql_query","arguments":{"company_name":"CLOSE_fin_03","table_name":"ledger","query":"WITH eligible AS (SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,recorded_at,revision,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind,event_key ORDER BY revision DESC) AS rn FROM ledger WHERE datetime(recorded_at)<=datetime('2026-10-24 12:00:00') AND business_date<='2026-10-23'), latest AS (SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,recorded_at,revision,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den FROM eligible WHERE rn=1 AND status<>'void'), inv AS (SELECT * FROM latest WHERE kind='invoice' AND vendor='BLUE' AND due_date<='2026-10-30'), calc AS (SELECT i.event_key,MAX(0,i.amount_minor-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount_minor) FROM latest p WHERE p.kind='payment' AND p.invoice_id=i.event_key),0)-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount_minor) FROM latest c WHERE c.kind='credit' AND c.invoice_id=i.event_key),0)) AS remaining,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(h.amount_minor) FROM latest h WHERE h.kind='hold' AND h.invoice_id=i.event_key AND h.status NOT IN ('release','void')),0) AS holds,COALESCE((SELECT t.discount_bps FROM latest t WHERE t.kind='terms' AND t.terms_code=i.terms_code AND t.business_date<=i.business_date ORDER BY t.business_date DESC LIMIT 1),0) AS discount_bps,i.discount_until,COALESCE((SELECT f.fx_num*1.0/f.fx_den FROM latest f WHERE f.kind='fx' AND f.currency=i.currency AND f.business_date<=i.business_date ORDER BY f.business_date DESC LIMIT 1),1.0) AS fx_rate FROM inv i), per_invoice AS (SELECT CAST((MAX(0,remaining-holds)*CASE WHEN discount_until>='2026-10-23' THEN (10000-discount_bps)/10000.0 ELSE 1.0 END*fx_rate)+0.5 AS INTEGER) AS usd_cents FROM calc) SELECT SUM(usd_cents) AS total_usd_cents FROM per_invoice WHERE usd_cents>=0"}}

{"tool":"sql_query","arguments":{"company_name":"CLOSE_fin_03","table_name":"ledger","query":"WITH eligible AS (SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,revision,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind,event_key ORDER BY revision DESC) AS rn FROM ledger WHERE datetime(recorded_at)<=datetime('2026-10-24 12:00:00') AND business_date<='2026-10-23'), latest AS (SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den FROM eligible WHERE rn=1 AND status<>'void'), inv AS (SELECT event_key,business_date,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code FROM latest WHERE kind='invoice' AND vendor='BLUE' AND due_date<='2026-10-30'), calc AS (SELECT i.event_key,MAX(0,i.amount_minor-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount_minor) FROM latest p WHERE p.kind='payment' AND p.invoice_id=i.event_key),0)-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount_minor) FROM latest c WHERE c.kind='credit' AND c.invoice_id=i.event_key),0)) AS remaining,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(h.amount_minor) FROM latest h WHERE h.kind='hold' AND h.invoice_id=i.event_key AND h.status NOT IN ('release','void')),0) AS holds,COALESCE((SELECT t.discount_bps FROM latest t WHERE t.kind='terms' AND t.terms_code=i.terms_code AND t.business_date<=i.business_date ORDER BY t.business_date DESC LIMIT 1),0) AS discount_bps,i.discount_until,COALESCE((SELECT f.fx_num*1.0/f.fx_den FROM latest f WHERE f.kind='fx' AND f.currency=i.currency AND f.business_date<=i.business_date ORDER BY f.business_date DESC LIMIT 1),1.0) AS fx_rate FROM inv i), per_invoice AS (SELECT CAST((MAX(0,remaining-holds)*CASE WHEN discount_until>='2026-10-23' THEN (10000-discount_bps)/10000.0 ELSE 1.0 END*fx_rate)+0.5 AS INTEGER) AS usd_cents FROM calc) SELECT SUM(usd_cents) AS total_usd_cents FROM per_invoice WHERE usd_cents>=0"}}
